messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled enable: model `lyra-quant-v2` -> catalog (eu-west-1). Canary: 1% for 30m. Change window starts 2026-03-22T22:00Z. Rollback TTL 15m. Notifying oncall. :rocket:
maria: Ack. Who's owning smoke tests and rollback threshold?
sam: I'll run smoke and perf checks. Plan: latency p50 <= 120ms, error rate < 0.5% during canary. If either breaches, we rollback.
anya: Suggest pinning `lyra-v1` for these production routes until canary is green: /text-gen and /chat. We should avoid silent traffic shift.
jeff: +1 to pin. Also recommend fallback ordering: lyra-quant-v2 -> lyra-quant-v1 -> generic-13b-compat. That keeps quant benefits but keeps latency fallback.
lisa: Oncall will be @lisa for the window. I'll monitor traces and token-cost deltas.
deploy-bot: Canary started (canary id: c-498765). Routing: 1% traffic -> lyra-quant-v2. Telemetry hooks: latency-experiment, cost-delta, safety-signals.
sam: Smoke note: running prompt set `canary_smoke_2026-03-22`. Will post results in 10m.
maria: Reminder: update release-notes snippet and send heads-up to support. Small blurb about fallback ordering and pin instructions.
jeff: If metrics show steady mild latency increase (<10%) but error rate OK, we keep canary and extend to 5% for 20m. If error spikes >0.5% rollback immediately.
sam: Smoke results: generation latency p50=118ms, p95=210ms, error=0.12%. Cost delta +6%. All green for 1% canary.
anya: Proceed with 5% expansion, but maintain `lyra-v1` pinned for top routes until 10% steady.
maria: rolling to 5% now. deploy-bot executing expansion.
deploy-bot: Expansion to 5% queued -> started. Expect completion in ~45s.
lisa: Observability: traces show a small tail at p99, investigating. Not seeing safety signs.
jeff: Keep an eye on token cost; set alert if cost-per-req rises >15% from baseline.
sam: 5% steady over 20m: p50 122ms, p95 215ms, error 0.15%. No rollback.
maria: Good. Schedule note: we'll unpin routes at 10% if stable for 1h. Add to release-notes: "Enabled lyra-quant-v2 (canary -> staged). Fallback order and pin guidance included."
deploy-bot: Canary extended to 10% per ops. Expansion starting.
lisa: During 10% increase, I saw one upstream retry pattern from a single client region; isolated to eu-central. Not impacting global error rate.
jeff: If isolated, leave it. If spreads to larger fraction, rollback.
maria: 10% stable at 35m. We'll keep pinned `lyra-v1` on critical routes for 1h more, then unpin if steady.
anya: I'll prepare rollback playbook snippet in case we need a fast pin rollback: `/api/route/pin set --model lyra-v1 --routes "chat,text-gen" --force`
sam: Perf baseline updated. I'll push small dashboard widgets for cost and latency deltas.
maria: Thanks all. I'll send a short post to #product with the release note and the ops summary. Closing thread unless any objections.
lisa: No objections. Great job team :tada:
